name: Findwork
tagline: Developer-focused job search API with remote and tech role filters.
description: Findwork is a developer-focused job board and search API for tech roles. It offers remote and on-site filters, tech stack and location queries, and structured job data so agents can search listings, surface remote roles, and power career tooling without scraping job boards.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY header; self-serve signup at findwork.dev

use_cases: search tech jobs by keyword and remote filter
list recent developer roles for a stack
fetch job detail by id for a listing
